"''I came with an ISB Marshal.|Avril Heert and Dedra Meero, mentioning the marshal in their argument|}} A [[human]] '''individual''' served in the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] for the [[Galactic Empire]] as an [[ISB Marshal]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. In [[1 BBY]], following a leak of information caused by [[Supervisor]] [[Lonni Jung]],{{Andor|Who Else Knows?}} the [[marshal]] accompanied Supervisor [[Avril Heert]] and [[Aide|Attendant]] [[Joydali]], on the orders of [[Major]] [[Lio Partagaz]], to arrest [[Lieutenant]] Supervisor [[Dedra Meero]] for her alledged involvement in the leak. ==Behind the scenes== The ISB Marshal appeared in "[[Make It Stop]]," the tenth episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']], which aired on [[May 13]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Make It Stop}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:ISB tactical agents]] [[Category:Marshals]]
